notes: The sibling of running-no-request with driver.kind terminal and nothing else changed: a gate node running while gates/approve.request.yml does not exist. Under a terminal driver that is the correct shape, not a defect - the question is asked and answered inside one turn and no request file is ever written - so the stop nudge must allow the stop. It is the state the nudge was replayed against on 2026-09-11 to show that a plugin-wide registration would block a correct terminal run; the fix makes the nudge read the driver, and this fixture is what holds it to that.
